text_en: Antiochus, son of King Demetrius, sent a letter from the islands of the sea to Simon, the priest and ethnarch of the Jews, and to all the nation;
text_cn: 德默特琉王的儿子安提约古，从海岛上致书给犹太人的首领息孟大司祭和一切犹太人民，

text_en: its contents were as follows: “King Antiochus to Simon the high priest and ethnarch and to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
text_cn: 内容如下：“安提约古王祝大司祭兼首领息孟及犹太人民安好！

text_en: Whereas certain scoundrels have gained control of the kingdom of our ancestors, and I intend to lay claim to the kingdom so that I may restore it as it formerly was, and have recruited a host of mercenary troops and have equipped warships,
text_cn: 昔日有些歹徒统治了我们的祖国， 我决意要将王国夺回，恢复原状；为此我招募许多军队，准备许多战船，

text_en: and intend to make a landing in the country so that I may proceed against those who have destroyed our country and those who have devastated many cities in my kingdom,
text_cn: 决意要登陆，向那些破坏了我国领土，使国内许多城邑变成废墟的人复仇。

text_en: now therefore I confirm to you all the tax remissions that the kings before me have granted you, and a release from all the other payments from which they have released you.
text_cn: 所以，凡先王过去对你所豁免的一切赋税，对你所豁免的任何其他贡品，现在我都加以追认。

text_en: I permit you to mint your own coinage as money for your country,
text_cn: 我还准许你，为你本国铸造自己的货币。

text_en: and I grant freedom to Jerusalem and the sanctuary. All the weapons that you have prepared and the strongholds that you have built and now hold shall remain yours.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷及圣所是自由区；凡你所制造的武器，所建筑的及你现在占据的堡垒，仍属于你。

text_en: Every debt you owe to the royal treasury and any such future debts shall be canceled for you from henceforth and for all time.
text_cn: 凡你所欠王的债，以及你将来应给王缴纳的，自今以后，永远豁免。

text_en: When we gain control of our kingdom, we will bestow great honor on you and your nation and the temple, so that your glory will become manifest in all the earth. ”
text_cn: 几时我们光复了王国，我还要盛大地光荣你、你的民族和圣殿，使你们光荣彰显于天下。”

text_en: In the one hundred seventy-fourth year Antiochus set out and invaded the land of his ancestors. All the troops rallied to him, so that there were only a few with Trypho.
text_cn: 一百七十四年， 安提约古进军祖国，一切军队都来归顺他，以致跟从特黎丰的人很少。

text_en: Antiochus pursued him, and Trypho came in his flight to Dor, which is by the sea;
text_cn: 安提约古王追击他，他只得逃往临海的多辣去了，

text_en: for he knew that troubles had converged on him, and his troops had deserted him.
text_cn: 因为他见祸患临头，军队又背离了他。

text_en: So Antiochus encamped against Dor, and with him were one hundred twenty thousand warriors and eight thousand cavalry.
text_cn: 安提约古便面对多辣扎营，跟从他的有步兵十二万，骑兵八千。

text_en: He surrounded the town, and the ships joined battle from the sea; he pressed the town hard from land and sea, and permitted no one to leave or enter it.
text_cn: 他将这城包围，海中的战船也在迫进，海陆一起夹攻，不准任何人出入。

text_en: Then Numenius and his companions arrived from Rome, with letters to the kings and countries, in which the following was written:
text_cn: 那时，奴默尼和他的同伴，从罗马回来，带着致众君王各邦国的书信，信上这样写道：

text_en: “Lucius, consul of the Romans, to King Ptolemy, greetings.
text_cn: “罗马执政路基犹祝仆托肋米王安好！

text_en: The envoys of the Jews have come to us as our friends and allies to renew our ancient friendship and alliance. They had been sent by the high priest Simon and by the Jewish people
text_cn: 息孟大司祭和犹太人民，派遣犹太使者，如我们的朋友与盟邦一样，来到我们这里，重订以前的友好同盟。

text_en: and have brought a gold shield weighing one thousand minas.
text_cn: 他们还带来一座一千“米乃”的金盾。

text_en: We therefore have decided to write to the kings and countries that they should not seek their harm or make war against them and their cities and their country, or make alliance with those who war against them.
text_cn: 所以我们乐意写信通告各位君王，各邦国：不可对犹太人图谋不轨，不可攻打他们、他们的城邑和国家，也不可与他们的敌人缔结同盟。

text_en: And it has seemed good to us to accept the shield from them.
text_cn: 我们乐意接受他们的金盾。

text_en: Therefore if any scoundrels have fled to you from their country, hand them over to the high priest Simon, so that he may punish them according to their law. ”
text_cn: 所以，若有歹徒，从他们国内逃到你们那里，你们应将他们交于息孟大司祭，使他按自己的法律惩治。”

text_en: The consul wrote the same thing to King Demetrius and to Attalus and Ariarathes and Arsaces,
text_cn: 执政者也将这事，写给德默特琉王、阿塔路、阿黎雅辣特和阿尔撒革，

text_en: and to all the countries, and to Sampsames, and to the Spartans, and to Delos, and to Myndos, and to Sicyon, and to Caria, and to Samos, and to Pamphylia, and to Lycia, and to Halicarnassus, and to Rhodes, and to Phaselis, and to Cos, and to Side, and to Aradus and Gortyna and Cnidus and Cyprus and Cyrene.
text_cn: 也写给各国，即散仆撒默、斯巴达人、德罗、明多、息基雍、加黎雅、撒摩、旁非里雅、里基雅、哈里加纳索、洛多、法色里、科斯、息德、阿辣多、哥尔提纳、克尼多、塞浦路斯、基勒乃等。

text_en: They also sent a copy of these things to the high priest Simon.
text_cn: 他们还将这信给息孟大司祭抄写了一份。

text_en: King Antiochus besieged Dor for the second time, continually throwing his forces against it and making engines of war; and he shut Trypho up and kept him from going out or in.
text_cn: 同时，安提约古在多辣附近扎营，不断进军攻城，并且制造军械，包围特黎丰，使他不能出入。

text_en: And Simon sent to Antiochus two thousand picked troops, to fight for him, and silver and gold and a large amount of military equipment.
text_cn: 这时，息孟派精兵两千来助战，同时还赠送金银和大批武器。

text_en: But he refused to receive them, and broke all the agreements he formerly had made with Simon, and became estranged from him.
text_cn: 无如安提约古不肯接受，反而废除了以前与息孟立订的一切盟约，待他如陌生人。

text_en: He sent to him Athenobius, one of his Friends, to confer with him, saying, “You hold control of Joppa and Gazara and the citadel in Jerusalem; they are cities of my kingdom.
text_cn: 安提约古王派遣他的一个朋友阿特诺彼，去见他与他商讨说：“你们占据了我王国的城邑约培、革则尔和在耶路撒冷的堡垒，

text_en: You have devastated their territory, you have done great damage in the land, and you have taken possession of many places in my kingdom.
text_cn: 蹂躏那些区域，在国内制造了严重的灾祸，还在我王国内占领了许多地方。

text_en: Now then, hand over the cities that you have seized and the tribute money of the places that you have conquered outside the borders of Judea;
text_cn: 所以，现在你们应归还你们所夺去的城邑，并将你们在犹太境外由占领地区所收的税交出。

text_en: or else pay me five hundred talents of silver for the destruction that you have caused and five hundred talents more for the tribute money of the cities. Otherwise we will come and make war on you. ”
text_cn: 若不然，就是付五百‘塔冷通’银子作代价，再为因你们的破坏而遭的损失，及你们由城中所收的税，另缴五百；再不然，我们就要来攻打你们。”

text_en: So Athenobius, the king’s Friend, came to Jerusalem, and when he saw the splendor of Simon, and the sideboard with its gold and silver plate, and his great magnificence, he was amazed. When he reported to him the king’s message,
text_cn: 王的朋友阿特诺彼，来到耶路撒冷，一见息孟的尊严、金杯银爵，以及许多侍从，很是惊奇，便向息孟报告了国王的话。

text_en: Simon said to him in reply: “We have neither taken foreign land nor seized foreign property, but only the inheritance of our ancestors, which at one time had been unjustly taken by our enemies.
text_cn: 息孟回答他说：“我们从来没有侵占过外人的土地，也没有抢掠过别人的财物，那都是我们祖先的产业，不过被敌人无理地强占了一些时候，

text_en: Now that we have the opportunity, we are firmly holding the inheritance of our ancestors.
text_cn: 我们只乘机夺回我们的祖业而已。

text_en: As for Joppa and Gazara, which you demand, they were causing great damage among the people and to our land; for them we will give you one hundred talents. ” Athenobius did not answer him a word,
text_cn: 至于你所要求的约培和革则尔，虽然二城严重地危害了人民和我国，但我们仍将付出一百‘塔冷通’代价。”

text_en: but returned in wrath to the king and reported to him these words, and also the splendor of Simon and all that he had seen. And the king was very angry.
text_cn: 使者一句话也没有回答他，气愤地回到国王那里，将这些话，和息孟的尊严，以及他所见的一切，向他报告了；王即勃然大怒。

text_en: Meanwhile Trypho embarked on a ship and escaped to Orthosia.
text_cn: 以后，特黎丰上船，逃到敖托息雅去了。

text_en: Then the king made Cendebeus commander-in-chief of the coastal country, and gave him troops of infantry and cavalry.
text_cn: 王便委派耕德巴为海滨地带的总司令，将步兵和骑兵都交给他，

text_en: He commanded him to encamp against Judea, to build up Kedron and fortify its gates, and to make war on the people; but the king pursued Trypho.
text_cn: 命令他面对犹太扎营，又命他修筑克德龙，巩固门户，攻打犹太人民；然后，王亲自追赶特黎丰去了。

text_en: So Cendebeus came to Jamnia and began to provoke the people and invade Judea and take the people captive and kill them.
text_cn: 耕德巴来到雅木尼雅，开始骚扰百姓，侵入犹太，捕杀人民。

text_en: He built up Kedron and stationed horsemen and troops there, so that they might go out and make raids along the highways of Judea, as the king had ordered him.
text_cn: 他按照王吩咐他的，修筑了克德龙，将骑兵与步兵屯驻在那里，以便巡逻犹太的通道。
